meta.purpose: Attribute vocabulary clustered. Passes 1-2 mechanical; pass 3 ruled.
rulings: RATE renamed SPEED; velocity, acceleration, flow, throughput moved into it.
MOTION keeps only the fact of moving: motion, movement, displacement, mobility, locomotion.
DIRECTION split out as its own cluster: path, trajectory, orientation, vector, axis, heading.
delta assigned to CHANGE, not MOTION -- a temperature delta is not motion.
phase assigned to TIME, not STATE -- 13 of 16 mentions are the bare temporal word.
COLOUR at 6 is accurate, not a parse failure: the source list is light on colour by design.
